version_name: Version 1.4.1 Alleva REST treatment-plan sync readiness
description: Separates Alleva REST API sync settings from FHIR readiness; adds a gated startup/manual Alleva treatment-plan sync path that imports active-client, treatment-plan, and treatment-review REST payloads into the R3 timeliness engine after approval and endpoint mapping validation; keeps compliance checking local to R3; and updates the API harness to use the REST API base URL without requiring a FHIR root.
